reviews.title: Used to be good, now I would highly avoid.
reviews.text: For 2 years this has been a great, free way for me to track my calories, now it’s awful. The past 3 updates have been terrible. They continue making the app harder and harder to use unless you pay. Like why can I not put in a half a serving of McDonald’s fries anymore. Why does that calculator thing even pop up. Go back to the old way where there is whole numbers and then qtr numbers for specific serving size. Quit updating the app yall clearly don’t know what you’re doing. Let me know when the app goes back to normal, for now I’ll have to find another app. Pitiful

reviews.title: Subscription charge
reviews.text: I enjoy the free version of this app very much. However, every time you open the app, it offers you to subscribe to their premium version. Today I accidentally subscribed to the premium version when I opened the app and was charged to my Apple account. I attempted to reach their customer service, but it was very difficult. I would like a refund for this accidental charge so I can continue enjoying this app.

reviews.title: Inaccurate
reviews.text: Used to be great, but recent updates have made it too much trouble to accurately log servings. Some foods also have inaccurate micros. Impossible to accurately log water. Scanning barcodes is the only benefit for this app over others.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I’ve been Using this app for years no complaints + scan barcodes on the free plan nice asf

reviews.title: fraudulent & a scam
reviews.text: upon opening the app, it advertised a free trial period. I signed up for the free trial and it immediately charged me for a full year. After reaching out to Apple they told me that they could not refund me, and I've reached out to the developer multiple times with no response. I even wrote a review and they responded to it asking me to email them and said that they would give me a full refund. I have reached out to them three times since then and I still have not received a response.

reviews.title: Shady sign up process
reviews.text: When I tried to sign up, the app offered me a “free trial” before the annual membership charge. I selected this option to try out the app. Then I immediately got charged the entire yearly subscription cost and did not receive a trial period at all. Would give 0 stars if I could.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: It’s been a while since I’ve used this pathetic app and it’s safe to say that I’m beyond disappointed with their new updates. In the older version, it was so much easier to log your food quantities and change between grams to oz. But now, they’ve made it a pain in the back to effectively log your food without having to pay. I really don’t understand why they chose to change something that already worked fine. It’s useless now.

reviews.title: No free trial!

reviews.title: App is now a lot less Optimal
reviews.text: I have been using this app for years to track cals and protein and just recently the UI has gotten so bad. Used to be one of the best apps now I would say one of the worst. Specifically you can’t set quantities directly from the search page. You must add the food item then go and change the quantity or see macro and micro breakdown. Please just revert the UI back to how it was, some of us had a good system going but now it’s just so bad.

reviews.title: Urgent fix need it
reviews.text: Great app, but it needs an urgent fix. It used to work great, but the June 8 update removed the ability to choose between grams and ounces. Please bring this feature back as soon as possible.

reviews.title: App ruined
reviews.text: App used to be perfect and extremely easy to search or scan a barcode. Now the camera setting is in .5 and will never focus on the barcode. The updates and AI slop they keep pushing every time you open the app ruined it

reviews.title: Bug needs fixed!!
reviews.text: I never really write reviews and I’ve used this app for a while now and have enjoyed it!! It’s easy and goal oriented!! However this year I FINALLY payed for a subscription and suddenly it is telling me my daily calories is 467?? I’ve loaded the app and it flashes to around 1,600 but then goes back to 467 and counts down from there!! Even my old entries are now saying I’m over my calorie count!! Need an update to fix this so I can get back on my grind please!!!

reviews.title: My opinion

You hit the button “save meal” and nothing saves on top of that I dislike that you cannot get the exact amount of water you drink it’s only goes up by a certain amount. Other than that the app is good for simple use and not more serious calorie tracking.
